title.en: Creating and Establishing the Philippine National Petroleum Center as An Integral Unit of the Petroleum Board, Defining Its Organization, Powers, Functions and Responsibilities and for Other Purposes

text.en:
There is hereby established a Philippine National Petroleum Center hereinafter referred to as the
Center, constituting an integral unit of the Petroleum Board.

The Center shall have the following purposes: (a) to ensure the country of a stead stream of
competent technical personnel; (b) to centralize all data and information on the country's petroleum resources;
(c) to provide supportive technical services to all oil exploration ventures through complete and modern
facilities.

The Center may set up various divisions within its organizational structure, as it may deem
necessary, such as a Petroleum Institute, a Petroleum Laboratory and a Petroleum Data Bank.

The Center shall be under the administrative control and supervision of the Petroleum Board
which such officers and personnel or employees as the Petroleum Board may appoint. Their compensation,
tenure of office and other terms and conditions relative to their appointment shall be determined by the
Petroleum Board.

The positions in the Center of officers and employees shall be considered technical and highly
confidential and as only may be on a part-time basis and shall be exempt from the requirements and
restrictions of the Civil Service Law, the Retirement Law, Section 29 of the Revised Administrative Code and
the laws, rules and regulations on position classification and salary standardization: Provided, That any retiree
employed in the center shall not be required to reimburse or refund any gratuity received from the
Government nor shall any pension or annuity to which he is entitled be suspended or reduced on account of
his employment in the Center.

In order for the support of the Center, the fees collected by the Petroleum Board on service

contracts or other agreements entered into pursuant to Presidential Decree No. 87, including the signature
bonuses paid thereunder shall henceforth receipted for separately as part of a special fund to be known as the
"Philippine National Petroleum Center Fund" and shall be set aside for the exclusive use of the Center in
accordance with this decree.

The Center shall be the sole central repository of all data and information on the country's
petroleum potentials and resources. For this purpose, it shall have the power to require reports and data from
service contractors under Presidential Decree No. 87, concessionaires under Republic Act No. 387, also
known as the Petroleum Act of 1949, and such other oil exploration and development companies that may
explore, exploit or develop petroleum resources in the Philippines. All such data now in the possession or
custody of any instrumentality or agency of the Government shall be turned over to the Center within thirty
(30) days after the effectivity of this decree.

Other Government offices and other Government-owned or controlled corporations shall extend
whatever assistance may be needed by the Center, including the detail of their officials and employees under
arrangements satisfactory to the Center and the other Government office or corporation concerned. Such
personnel may be given honorarium by the Center, any law to the contrary notwithstanding.

All acts, or parts of acts, decrees, general orders, executive orders, proclamations, rules and
regulations inconsistent herewith are repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 8th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
